scenarios.name: The Greatest Job in the World

items.name: Eagle-Eye Goggles
items.desc: During your attack, gain Advantage on the entire Attack action.

items.name: Iron Helmet
items.desc: When attacked, consider any {2X_WHITE} attack modifier card the enemy draws to be a {+0_WHITE} instead.

items.name: Chain Armor
items.desc: During your turn gain {SHIELD} 1 for the rest of the round

items.name: Studded Leather
items.desc: When attacked, the attacker gains Disadvantage on the attack and you gain {SHIELD} 1 for the attack.

items.name: Weathered Boots
items.desc: During your movement add +1 {MOVE} to a single movement.

items.name: Winged Shoes
items.desc: During your movement, add {JUMP} to the entire Move Action.
items.faq: Winged Shoes may be used for only a single movement ability, not for multiple movement abilities of an action (ex: Action with Move, Attack, Move).

items.name: Heater Shield
items.desc: When damaged by an attack, gain {SHIELD} 1 for the attack.

items.name: Throwing Hammer
items.desc: During your ranged attack, add {STUN} to a single attack

items.name: Poison Dagger
items.desc: During your melee attack, add {POISON} to a single attack.

items.name: Iron Spear
items.desc: During your single-target melee Attack ability, attack any one enemy within 2 hexes

items.name: Healing Potion
items.desc: During your turn, perform a “{HEAL} 3, Self” action.

items.name: Stamina Potion
items.desc: During your turn, return one of your discarded cards to your hand.

items.name: Power Potion
items.desc: During your attack, add +1 {ATTACK} to your entire Attack action.

items.name: Mana Potion
items.desc: During your turn, infuse any one element. {ANY}

items.name: Amulet of Life
items.desc: During your turn, “{HEAL} 1, Self” action.

items.name: Robes of Evocation
items.desc: During your attack, {ANY_X} to add +1 {ATTACK} to the entire Attack action.

items.name: Comfortable Shoes
items.desc: Whenever you use the default bottom of an ability card, perform a {MOVE} 3 action instead of a {MOVE} 2 action.

items.name: Battle-Axe
items.desc: During your single-target melee attack action, turn the attack into the following: {AOE.CONE_0_1}

items.name: Black Candle
items.desc: During your ranged attack, add {CURSE} to a single attack.

items.name: Stun Powder
items.desc: During your attack, add {STUN} to a single attack.

items.name: Hawk Helm
items.desc: During your ranged attack, add +1 {RANGE} to your entire Attack action.

items.name: Bladed Armor
items.desc: When damaged by an attack, gain {SHIELD} 2 for the attack and the attacker suffers 2 damage.

items.name: Boots of Striding
items.desc: During your movement, add +2 {MOVE} to a single movement.

items.name: Volatile Bomb
items.desc: During your single-target ranged attack action, turn the attack into the following: {AOE.CONE_1_1}

items.name: Barbed Chain
items.desc: During your ranged attack, add {PULL} 2 to a single attack.

items.name: Oak Charm
items.desc: During your turn, perform a “{BLESS}, {RANGE} 5” action.

items.name: Fateful Compass
items.desc: During your turn, force one enemy within {RANGE} 3 to peform a “{MOVE} 2” action with you controlling the action.

items.name: Flea-Bitten Shawl
items.source:
Reward from Scenario #8
Reward from Scenario #12
items.desc: You are considered to have an initiative of 99 for the purpose of enemy focusing.
items.faq: The item does not actually change a character's initiative so it doesn't affect their summons' initiative. It only changes how monster's treat the character during focus evaluation.

items.name: Tower Shield
items.desc: When damaged by an attack, gain {SHIELD} 2 for the attack.

items.name: Ring of Haste
items.desc: At the end of your turn, play one card from your hand and immediately perform the bottom action of that card.

items.name: Ring of Strength
items.desc: During your turn, gain {STRENGTHEN}.

items.name: Ring of Restoration
items.desc: During your turn, perform a “{HEAL} 3, {RANGE} 5” action.

items.name: Steel Ring
items.desc: When damaged by an attack, gain {SHIELD} 4 for the attack.

items.name: Barbed Axe
items.desc: During your attack, add {WOUND} to the entire Attack Action.

items.name: Robes of Command
items.desc: During your turn, one adjacent ally may perform and “{ATTACK} 2” Action.

items.name: Jet Boots
items.desc: During your movement, add “+1 {MOVE} and {JUMP}” to a single movement.
